w1.item: tests/site.spec.mjs lists pages from ../dist instead of SITE_DIST; import DIST from tools/lib.mjs (ia owns tests split — coordinate: ia writes the split specs, build makes lib DIST the single source).
check-links --url-map=FILE should exit 1 when an explicitly named map file is missing.

CONTRACT §11: build must fail when any inline <script> is not byte-equal to an INLINE_SCRIPTS entry; serve.mjs must apply netlify.toml headers incl. CSP. The INLINE_SCRIPTS hash check in build.mjs is already done at seed.
Deprecated event intents are double-quoted in event-schema.yaml; detect them with a quote-tolerant regex /^"?Deprecated:/ or a real YAML parse.
